tasks.label: Bootstrap Python 3.14 Environment
tasks.command: python3.14 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -U pip && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -e ".[dev]"

tasks.label: Quality Gate
tasks.command: .venv/bin/python -m pytest && .venv/bin/ruff check src tests && .venv/bin/ruff format --check src tests && .venv/bin/mypy src
